chunks: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us, from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab, from Nasr b. Muzahim, from 'Umar b. Sa'd, from Arta'ah b. Habib, from Fudayl al-Rassan, from Jabala al-Makkiyyah. She said: I heard Maytham al-Tammar (may Allah sanctify his soul) say:

By Allah! This nation shall kill the son of its Prophet in Muharram, when ten days have passed from it. The enemies of Allah shall take that day as a day of blessing, and that shall come to pass, for it has preceded in the knowledge of Allah, exalted be His mention. I know that through a covenant entrusted to me by my master, the Commander of the Faithful (blessings of Allah be upon him). And he informed me that everything shall weep over him -- even the wild beasts in the deserts, the fish in the seas, the birds in the middle of the sky. The sun, the moon, the stars, the heaven, the earth, the believing humans and jinn, all the angels of the heavens, Ridwan and Malik and the bearers of the Throne shall weep over him, and the sky shall rain blood and ashes.

Then he said: The curse of Allah is incumbent upon the killers of Husayn (peace be upon him), just as it is incumbent upon the polytheists who appoint another god alongside Allah, and just as it is incumbent upon the Jews, the Christians, and the Zoroastrians.

Jabala said: I said to him: O Maytham, how will the people take the day on which Husayn b. 'Ali (peace be upon them) is killed as a day of blessing?! Maytham (may Allah be pleased with him) wept, then said: They will claim through a hadith they fabricate that it is the day on which Allah forgave Adam (peace be upon him), while Allah forgave Adam in Dhu al-Hijjah. They claim it is the day on which Allah accepted the repentance of Dawud (peace be upon him), while Allah accepted his repentance in Dhu al-Hijjah. They claim it is the day on which Allah brought forth Yunus (peace be upon him) from the belly of the whale, while Allah brought him forth in Dhu al-Qi'dah. They claim it is the day on which the ark of Nuh (peace be upon him) came to rest on Mount Judi, while it came to rest on the eighteenth of Dhu al-Hijjah. And they claim it is the day on which Allah split the sea for the Children of Israel, while that was in Rabi' al-Awwal.

Then Maytham said: O Jabala, know that Husayn b. 'Ali (peace be upon them) is the master of the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection, and his companions are a degree above all other martyrs. O Jabala, when you see the sun turn red as if it were fresh blood, know that your master Husayn has been killed.

Jabala said: I went out one day and saw the sun upon the walls as if it were blankets dyed in safflower. So I shrieked at that moment and wept, and I said: By Allah! Our master Husayn b. 'Ali (peace be upon them) has been killed!

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful, title of Imam Ali
key_terms.الجودي: Mount Judi, where the Ark of Nuh came to rest
key_terms.المحرم: Muharram, the first month of the Islamic calendar
key_terms.سيد الشهداء: Master of the Martyrs, title of Imam Husayn

ai.seo_question: What did Maytham al-Tammar prophesy about Imam Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: Maytham al-Tammar, the loyal companion of Imam Ali, prophesies to Jabala al-Makkiyyah that this nation will kill the Prophet's grandson Husayn on the tenth of Muharram. He describes how all of creation will weep for Husayn, and warns that the enemies will fabricate hadiths to celebrate Ashura as a day of blessing by attributing false events to it. The hadith concludes with Jabala witnessing the blood-red sun as a sign of Husayn's martyrdom.
